Project.NAME: IdentityService (MIF)
Project.keywords: mif, identity-management, keycloak, cqrs, reader, writer, worker
Project.annotation: User and role management in MIF. IdentityService.Api.ReaderService (query cache), IdentityService.Api.WriterService (command gateway), IdentityService.WorkerService (saga processor + Keycloak sync).

M-SHARED.NAME: IdentityService.Shared
M-SHARED.purpose: User, role, event DTOs shared across Reader, Writer, Worker

M-READER.NAME: IdentityService.Api.ReaderService
M-READER.purpose: Query-only API: user/role cache from MongoDB, token introspection

M-WRITER.NAME: IdentityService.Api.WriterService
M-WRITER.purpose: Command gateway API: routes user provisioning and role sync commands to MQ

M-WORKER.NAME: IdentityService.WorkerService
M-WORKER.purpose: Saga processor: provision users and sync roles bidirectionally with Keycloak

class-SyncRoleSaga.PURPOSE: Role sync saga: bidirectional Keycloak ↔ MongoDB (completed)

M-KEYCLOAK.NAME: IdentityService.KeycloakAdapter
M-KEYCLOAK.purpose: Keycloak admin API client + JWT validator with JWKS cache

M-CACHE.NAME: IdentityService.CacheLayer
M-CACHE.purpose: MongoDB user/role cache: fast queries without Keycloak calls
